verdict.rationale: Clerky provides a controlled, template-based workflow for legal paperwork. Users customize key terms, swap the underlying forms, collaborate on document sets in real time, bring in an attorney to review and comment, and every change is logged, which replaces passing email attachments around. There is no evidence of counterparty negotiation or redlining (tracked changes or version comparison) of contract text, and the product is focused on startup formation, equity and financing documents rather than general contracts. Missing for 10: redlining/tracked-changes capability, counterparty negotiation workflow, support for general commercial contracts, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can draft, negotiate, and redline contracts in a controlled workflow instead of email attachments

citations.quote: Our software makes it easy to customize the key terms of the legal paperwork you're working on.
If you need to customize documents beyond the provided fields, you can swap out the underlying forms for any of our products.
Our software makes it easy to invite other people to collaborate on a document set, in real-time.
you can easily loop in your attorney to have them review and comment on the information you're entering.
We log every change anyone makes to a document set or workspace, so you can always see who was responsible for what.
